name: Tengoku Blueprints
description: In Tengoku, {{share}}% of the blueprints medium chests give are Tengoku (H4) blueprints, instead of about 1 in 400. Set it in Configuration.
author: KSFA

settings.label: Tengoku blueprint share
settings.help: How many of the blueprints a Tengoku medium chest gives are Tengoku blueprints (the ones for Tengoku's own gear, their id ending in H4). The game's own share is about 1 in 400. Every chest list keeps its total, and every other blueprint stays in it. 0 leaves them alone.

settings.label: The most medium chests on every floor
settings.help: On: every Tengoku floor that can have medium chests gets the most it can (3, where the game rolls 1 to 3). Off: the game's own roll.

patches.sql: WITH h AS (SELECT DISTINCT grp FROM master_item WHERE itemtype = 'ITTP_RMAP' AND itemid LIKE '%H4'), r AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT flrid, areaid, refareaid, grp, freq, grp IN (SELECT grp FROM h) AS g FROM master_floor_drop_gen WHERE flrid LIKE 'HVN%' AND type = 'PTGENTP_TRBOX_M' AND {{share}} > 0), l AS (SELECT flrid, areaid, refareaid, SUM(freq) AS t, SUM(CASE WHEN g THEN freq ELSE 0 END) AS gs, SUM(CASE WHEN g THEN 0 ELSE freq END) AS ns, SUM(1 - g) AS nn FROM r GROUP BY flrid, areaid, refareaid HAVING gs > 0 AND ns > 0), x AS (SELECT flrid, areaid, refareaid, t, gs, ns, MIN(MAX(1, t * {{share}} / 100), t - nn) AS f FROM l), n AS (SELECT r.flrid, r.areaid, r.refareaid, r.grp, MAX(1, r.freq * (x.t - x.f) / x.ns) AS f FROM r JOIN x USING (flrid, areaid, refareaid) WHERE NOT r.g), lg AS (SELECT x.flrid, x.areaid, x.refareaid, x.gs, x.t - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(n.f) FROM n WHERE n.flrid = x.flrid AND n.areaid = x.areaid AND n.refareaid = x.refareaid), 0) AS gt FROM x), gr AS (SELECT r.flrid, r.areaid, r.refareaid, r.grp, r.freq * lg.gt / lg.gs AS f, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.flrid, r.areaid, r.refareaid ORDER BY r.freq DESC, r.grp) AS rn FROM r JOIN lg USING (flrid, areaid, refareaid) WHERE r.g), nw AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT flrid, areaid, refareaid, grp, f FROM n UNION ALL SELECT gr.flrid, gr.areaid, gr.refareaid, gr.grp, MAX(1, gr.f + CASE WHEN gr.rn = 1 THEN lg.gt - (SELECT SUM(y.f) FROM gr y WHERE y.flrid = gr.flrid AND y.areaid = gr.areaid AND y.refareaid = gr.refareaid) ELSE 0 END) FROM gr JOIN lg USING (flrid, areaid, refareaid)) UPDATE master_floor_drop_gen SET freq = nw.f FROM nw WHERE master_floor_drop_gen.flrid = nw.flrid AND master_floor_drop_gen.areaid = nw.areaid AND master_floor_drop_gen.refareaid = nw.refareaid AND master_floor_drop_gen.type = 'PTGENTP_TRBOX_M' AND master_floor_drop_gen.grp = nw.grp;

patches.description: Tengoku floors: always the most medium chests
patches.sql:
UPDATE master_floor SET mtbmin = mtbmax WHERE id LIKE 'HVN%' AND mtbmax > 0;
UPDATE master_tmpfloor_stage SET mtbmin = mtbmax WHERE id LIKE 'HVN%' AND mtbmax > 0;
